data.text:
LOOK: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., along with First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos and their son Vinny, scale the old Kamuning Footbridge in Quezon City. 

The President in June 2025 ordered the infamous "Mt. Kamuning" to be tore down and replaced with a more accessible and commuter-friendly footbridge.

President Marcos, Transportation Secretary Giovanni Lopez and DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon then inspect the newly built Kamuning Footbridge and Busway Station Project, which cost P87 million. 

Cost breakdown, per DoTr:
Footbridge: P54,741,056.22
Busway Station: P32,585,758.88
